The harness takes the sample rate only from an options block, which a payload of 1024 bytes or less does not have and in which it can be 0; this input leaves it at 0, and the siren decoder, which sets AV_CODEC_CAP_CHANNEL_CONF but never a sample rate, outputs a frame with sample_rate 0, which frame_validate() (libavcodec/decode.c) turns into AVERROR_BUG. control.bin is the same packet with an options block that sets the sample rate to 8000. | [spice-usbredir/usbredirfilterfuzz/asan_agrees](../projects/spice-usbredir/usbredirfilterfuzz/) | suspected false | The fuzz target calls abort() when fopen("/dev/null", "wb") fails (source/usbredirfilterfuzz.cc:41-44), and musl's fopen calls openat before it allocates (musl f21a9653, src/stdio/fopen.c:21-26). In LPS f1006fe8, openat is a file-system call (Run.v:1363) that may fail at random under both readings, because alloc-forced-only restricts only memory requests (Run.v:1315-1316; Shapes.v:79, :88-90), and the open of /dev/null may fail with ENOMEM, EACCES, EMFILE or ENFILE (Sys/Fs/Open.v:946-959, :268-273).
